editorial:
Imagine jumping back to the 1980s with neon lights, big hair, and a whole lot of synth music. You get to follow Diana as she tries to fit into a world that has changed since her last big fight. She is still the powerful hero you love, but she is feeling a bit lonely. Everything changes when a magical stone shows up, giving people their deepest desires but taking something precious in return. You will see Diana deal with a new kind of villain who uses greed and lies to try and take over the world, making the whole vibe feel like a colorful comic book come to life.

Gal Gadot is great as always, and the action scenes are bright and loud. While the plot gets a bit messy in the middle and some of the special effects look a little fake, the heart of the story is still there. If you want a fun ride without thinking too hard, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: Diana realizes that the wish stone creates a world based on lies. To stop the chaos, she makes a final wish to take back every wish ever made from the stone. This wipes out the villain's power and fixes the world, but it also means Steve Trevor has to disappear again. Diana accepts this loss because she knows the world needs to be honest to truly be happy. She ends up back in her normal life, stronger and wiser.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves superheroes and 80s nostalgia.
